question: What is supreme reflection called?
premises: It is marked by duality attainment.
It is in supreme emanation self, Shiva-Shakti nonduality.
inference: Supreme reflection is the attainment marked by nondual Shiva-Shakti emanation.
plain_english: Supreme reflection is indeed called, marked by duality attainment, in supreme emanation self, Shiva-Shakti nonduality.
